The armchair sits to the east facing into the seating group, while the floor lamp is positioned to the west. The rug remains in the open foreground rather than overlapping floor-supported furniture, preserving clear circulation from the south side and around the seating area. Small living-room accessories rest on the coffee table, while the books rest on the south-wall shelf. Wall art and sconces form a balanced arrangement above the sofa; the mirror, canvas, and clock use the side walls without obstructing movement.
[/Reason]
